metadata.title: Infinitesimally polar Killing foliations via geometric resolutions
metadata.abstract: We establish the strong Molino conjecture for complete infinitesimally polar singular Riemannian foliations and identify their Molino sheaves with those of their geometric resolutions. The resolution preserves basic and equivariant basic cohomology and transverse curvature bounds. These comparisons yield orbifold models and approximations of leaf-closure spaces, Euler localization, closed-leaf existence and Euler positivity under positive curvature, and transverse sphere theorems. Maximal defect gives a closed-ball leaf-closure space. Further applications include fundamental-group growth bounds and closedness under nonpositive transverse Ricci curvature that is negative definite at one regular point.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.workSummary: 证明完备无穷小极性的奇异黎曼叶状结构满足强 Molino 猜想，并通过几何消解比较 Molino 层、基本及等变基本上同调和横向曲率。
analysis.breakthrough: 把结构定理转化为叶闭包空间的 orbifold 模型、Euler 局部化及横向球定理等应用。
analysis.limitations: 结论限于无穷小极性；正曲率与非正 Ricci 应用分别有自身附加条件。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

analysis.priorityReason: 奇异叶状结构中的基础猜想与多项比较应用，覆盖面较广。
